calendar_ownership.completed_source_h1: same-calendar-year diagnostic/reference only; never relabeled or double-counted

selection_history.fitted_fold_pattern: production MAE improved in all three fitted folds; state Brier/log loss improved in 2019 and 2020 and were slightly worse in 2018
selection_history.developmental: recall improved from 0.97297 to 0.98198 while false positives fell from 111 to 109
selection_history.temporary_absence: state Brier slightly improved; persistence Brier slightly worsened

subgroup_cautions: QB production MAE and state quality improve, but production bias moves from near zero to approximately -7 points on average.
RB state Brier/log loss are slightly worse while production MAE improves.

TE state Brier/log loss and production MAE are modestly worse in the confirmation fold; TE had improved across the broader selection history, so this is a stability caution rather than a coherent cross-era failure.
Persistence Brier is slightly worse overall even though broader state/threshold calibration and production accuracy improve.

selection_judgment: Direct h=3 meets the frozen protocol: it shows a coherent and repeatable production-accuracy advantage, aggregate state/log-loss improvement, stronger starter/premium calibration, no developmental false-optimism regression, stable temporary-absence state safety, and coherent untouched confirmation. The remaining subgroup reversals are modest and mixed rather than material safety failures. Longer-horizon uncertainty and the TE/RB/QB-bias cautions must remain visible in implementation/reporting.
